{{Quote|Until I'm dead&hellip;I'm the one&hellip;who gives the orders.|Lock's final words|<ref name="breakout squad" />}}
'''Lock''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. A veteran of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], he eventually led a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the [[Mission to Kynachi]], where he [[Death/Legends|perished]] with the squad's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] unit would later become known as "[[Breakout Squad]]." Lock was in charge of a clean-up crew on the planet where the ship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] was destroyed. Lock came up with the nicknames [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]], [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]], and [[Chatterbox]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="clone troopers" /> the [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] nicknamed Lock<ref name="breakout squad" /> was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" />

===First Battle of Geonosis===
In [[22 BBY]], the conflict of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] started with the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], in which Lock participated.<ref name="breakout squad" />

===Mission to the Kaliida Nebula===
{{Quote|I'll bet Grievous is crying droid tears right now over his broken toy.''"<br />"''Don't forget that this 'broken toy' destroyed dozens of Republic warships and killed thousands of allies.|Sharp and Lock|<ref name="breakout squad" />}}
Shortly after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led the successful mission to destroy the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], Captain Lock was assigned to search through the wreckage for any indications of which organization had built the Separatist battleship. Lock arrived at the Kalida Nebula in the star destroyer [[Demolisher (Venator-class)|''Demolisher'']]. He took the clone trooper [[Shiny/Legends|shinies]] [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|CT-8863]], [[Sharp (clone trooper)|CT-4012]] and [[Chatterbox|CT-5177]] down to the ''Malevolence'' crash site with a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]]. During the mission, Lock, feeling it inconvenient for the three troopers to call each other by their number, assigned them with nicknames based on one of their skills. CT-4012 received the nickname "Sharp" for spotting the insignia of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] in the wreckage. CT-8863 received Breaker, which was short for "circuit breaker," after he had discovered a circuit board with an exotic design. As Captain Lock turned to give CT-5177 his nickname, a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] rose from the wreckage and starting shooting at the clones. CT-5177 was hit and collapsed while the other clones returned fire. The droid was easily destroyed, but CT-5177 was badly injured. Lock deemed the mission over and they hurried with their wounded comrade to the shuttle and up to the star destroyer for medical aid. Lock demanded that his brother would live, and would not reveal his new nickname unless he did survive.

===Mission to Kynachi===
They were soon assigned to a new mission to the planet [[Kynachi]] where the exotic circuit board had been manufactured. Lock and his troopers along with a recovered CT-5177 assembled in the Jedi Temple's landing bay. He then revealed that the clone's nickname was Chatterbox, which was an irony on the clone's silent nature. For the mission he was put under the command of Jedi General [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] and received 11 clones plus two pilots. They were to travel to Kynachi in secret and was to use an unmarked freighter. Unbeknownst to Lock and the rest of the crew, the shuttle had been sabotaged, and as soon as the freighter exited hyperspace, it was attacked by Separatist forces. Lock was in the cockpit of the freighter as the attack began, and attempted to warn the passengers of incoming droid fighters, but his voice was cut off as an explosion rocked the ship. The troopers attempted to abandon ship, but the launch systems for the escape pods had been tampered with, requiring a manual launch from the freighter. After the first pod was launched, Breaker, Knuckles, Chatterbox and [[Nuru Kungurama]] jumped into the second one, but the group eventually realized that someone had to stay behind to launch the final pod. By that time, a badly injured Lock had managed to limp his way to the pods. Breaker told the captain to get into the pod while he remained to launch it. However, understanding his situation, he pushed Breaker into the pod and launched it, with his final words that until he was dead, he would be the one who gave orders. As the escape pod soared towards the planet, the freighter exploded, incinerating Lock and everything aboard.

==Personality and traits==
Lock showed both concern for his troops and a desire for his fellow clones to become more like individuals, as he personally wanted to come up with nicknames for the clones. He showed a willingness to sacrifice himself for his men, as well as making it clear that he was in charge when he shoved Breaker into the escape pod.<ref name="breakout squad" />

==Equipment==
Captain Lock wore a standard clone armor that was "scuffed and scratched", with a battered helmet that was decorated with jagged blue markings.

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]] mini-game, "Card Commander", a different [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Clone Captain Lock]] is mistakenly credited with Lock's last words.
